access: A scratch schema or a clone the agent may write to for the one-unit dry run; writes to production history only after the user approves the plan

presentation.name: Plan and run a backfill that changes only what it should
presentation.summary: Plans a backfill or replay of historical data so it rewrites only the intended window, can be paused, resumed and rolled back, and ends with a reconciliation of what changed and a notice to the people who read the numbers.
benefits: Checks that the input still covers the window and still means what it did, before any history is overwritten
Snapshots the target and dry-runs one unit, so the change is predicted before it is made
Runs unit by unit on isolated compute with pinned code, and rebuilds the downstream models that a normal run would miss
Reconciles before against after and drafts the notice of what changed
